tools.name: romanize_korean_name
tools.description: Romanize a Korean personal name (Hangul) the way it usually appears in passports/English docs: common surname spelling (김=Kim, 이=Lee, 박=Park, 2-syllable surnames like 남궁), given name joined and hyphenated, Western and Korean order. Free.

tools.name: romanize_korean
tools.description: Revised Romanization of Korean (official South Korean standard) for arbitrary Hangul text, with basic liaison rules. Free.

tools.name: korean_address_to_english
tools.description: Convert a Korean road-name address (Hangul) to English order and romanization for shipping labels / forms, e.g. 서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 123 -> 123, Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. Free.

tools.name: validate_korean_brn
tools.description: Validate a South Korean business registration number (사업자등록번호, 10 digits) checksum and format it as XXX-XX-XXXXX. Checksum only; does not confirm the business is active. Free.

tools.name: clean_korean_product_title
tools.description: Strip promo noise ([무료배송], ★초특가★, 정품, etc.) from Korean marketplace (Coupang, Naver, Gmarket) product titles before translation or matching. Free.
